propositions: inbound_differ is ADD-only by design and never removes links deleted on the peer side, creating asymmetry with outbound direction which has a removal path
the apply layer silently discards non-add link records at apply_inbound_records.py:560-562, so even a corrected differ cannot execute removals without applying the action-branch fix

arbitrating between inbound removal and outbound addition for a managed dep requires distinguishing never-pushed local links from peer-deleted links, which is impossible with only current state (managed_refs alone)
the shipped semantics are local-wins-and-restore: a link deleted in Jira is re-added on the next pass, convergent and safe, identical across Cloud and DC backends

guards G1 (observe issuelinks key present), G2 (bound target), G3 (managed ref), and G5 (relation match) are load-bearing and prevent silent data loss from truncated enrichments; G4 arbitration and history signal remain unresolved for full removal implementation
